title: GenerationFunctionResponse
description: Parsed LLM output for llm.generation.function: candidate function implementation.

entity_target_id.description: EntityId of the function being generated.

candidate_source_bytes.description: Base64-encoded source bytes for the function implementation candidate.

declarations_required.description: Declaration entity IDs or artifact references required to compile this candidate.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made while generating the function.

dependencies.description: EntityIds or artifact references this function depends on.

unsupported_behavior.description: Behavior the implementation explicitly does not handle.

proposed_tests.description: Test IDs proposed for this function.

source_evidence_references.description: Evidence references used to derive the function.
